title: CONNECT-UDP Forwarding Policy Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9298 forwarding, congestion, QUIC DATAGRAM sizing, oversized-payload, inner-header, and ECN policy helpers.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectUdpForwardingPolicy` captures allocation-free decisions for burstiness, batching, congestion-control disablement, ECN signaling, HTTP/3 and QUIC DATAGRAM preference, QUIC DATAGRAM payload limits, oversized-payload drop and ICMP Packet Too Big recommendation, inner IP header prohibition, and outbound UDP ECN control.
data_and_state_considerations: The policy is stateless and does not emit packets or mutate live QUIC/UDP state. Live adapters consume these decisions when forwarding is integrated.
edge_cases_and_constraints: Congestion control can only be disabled with out-of-band certainty.
ECN support is not signaled when congestion control is disabled.
Oversized UDP payloads are dropped rather than sent as DATAGRAM capsules when QUIC DATAGRAM is in use.
Outbound UDP ECN is fixed to Not-ECT.
risks: Live ICMP Packet Too Big emission remains adapter work.
Live PMTU discovery integration remains adapter work.
The helper does not implement UDP socket forwarding itself.
